description: A photograph shows a coastal lagoon ecosystem, featuring a sandy landform, possibly a spit or peninsula, under a clear sky. The sandy area extends from the foreground into the midground, dividing a body of calm water. To the left of the sandy feature, a wider expanse of water is visible. To the right, another body of water shows ripples on its surface. A dense treeline or band of vegetation is visible on the distant bank across the water. The image is attributed with "© Copernicus (year)/2017" and "CLMS" (Copernicus Land Monitoring Service) in the bottom left corner.
